call_purpose: You wanted to resolve an issue where some of your students' lesson videos keep loading and do not play, mostly on their phones.

covered.text: We checked an affected lesson on several browsers and a phone and could not reproduce the problem from our side, so this issue is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
